key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Radius of the rounded window corners, in logical pixels.

key.name: corner-smoothing
key.description: 0 draws a circular arc; higher values draw a smoother squircle (superellipse) corner.

key.name: round-shadow
key.description: Reshape the window's native shadow so it follows the rounded corners instead of sticking out as a square.

key.name: border-width
key.description: Width of a border drawn along the rounded window edge, in logical pixels. 0 disables it.

key.name: border-color
key.description: CSS color of the border, for example rgba(255,255,255,0.15).

key.name: round-maximized
key.description: Keep the corners rounded on maximized windows. Fullscreen windows are never rounded.

key.name: round-tiled
key.description: Round windows tiled to half of the screen.

key.name: round-dialogs
key.description: Round dialog and utility windows too, not only normal windows.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: WM_CLASS or application IDs (e.g. org.gnome.Calculator) whose windows are never rounded.
